Oink 0.3.4 adds automatic unlock, Paste as File and layout shortcuts, and fixes several pointer, shortcut and audio issues.

## New

- Automatic unlock: move the pointer from an unlocked computer onto a locked Mac or Windows computer, and Oink unlocks it with the saved password. The password is verified when you save it and is stored encrypted on that computer.
- Paste as File: turn it on under Tools in Settings to save text or images on the clipboard as a file from the context menu in Finder or File Explorer.
- Saved layouts can have shortcuts, so you can switch layouts with one key combination.
- The middle and side mouse buttons can be used as shortcuts.
- Hiding a screen in the layout now applies on every device in the group, and offline devices can be hidden or moved as a whole.
- On Windows, after turning on "Disable hidden displays in the system" in Settings, screens hidden in the layout are also disabled in Windows, so the pointer can't stray onto them.
- Moving devices with several screens in the layout works better.
- On Windows, keyboard and mouse input simulated by other apps is now forwarded to other devices by default. You can turn this off in Settings.
- When audio forwarding ends, media that is playing is paused before local sound is restored.
- Oink is now available for Intel Macs.

## Fixes

- Fixed the pointer not being able to return to the computer's other screens after entering a screen hidden in the layout.
- Fixed a still cursor being left at the top of the screen after opening Mission Control on a Mac.
- Fixed shortcuts held down while the computer locks no longer working.
- Fixed external input also not working on a Mac whose local input is disabled.
- Fixed images copied on one Windows computer showing no preview in clipboard history (Win+V) on another Windows computer.
- Fixed default pointer shortcuts for a device sometimes duplicating existing shortcuts.
- Fixed pairing occasionally failing.
- Fixed the audio warning still being shown after audio output recovers.
- Fixed the pitch of forwarded audio jumping after quiet passages.
- Fixed Num Lock not taking effect on the remote device.
- Fixed some UI issues.

## Compatibility

- 0.3.4 works with 0.3.0 and later.

## Downloads

- **Mac (Apple silicon):** the `.dmg` file — macOS 14.2 or later.
- **Mac (Intel):** the `.dmg` file marked `x64` — macOS 14.2 or later.
- **Windows:** the `.msi` file — x64, Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later, or Windows 11.
